title: Philippines BPO Client Portfolio
thesis: Snowflake turns daily client account activity from a fictional Philippine BPO provider into escalation and SLA KPIs, 7-day SLA breach risk scores, repeat contact rate anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on one governed platform.

talking_points: Contacts without escalation, escalations raised, SLA breaches and billed revenue in PHP for 40 fictional client accounts served from Quezon City, Cebu City, Davao City, Iloilo City and Bacolod.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to account-day rows.
The escalation-type chart shows which escalations miss the SLA and which are always closed within it, such as site connectivity outages.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of client portfolio KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which accounts should the quality team watch first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each account's probability of an SLA breach in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags repeat contact rate outliers per account, and the forecast projects portfolio-wide escalations for 14 days to plan team-lead cover.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: Are our quality controls keeping up?

talking_points: QA audit compliance, agent certification coverage and agents still in certification training frame the control gaps.
QA audit compliance against SLA breaches by account shows where missed calibration audits and SLA breaches move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, account, escalation-type and risk tables only.
show: QA audit compliance and certification coverage
QA audit compliance vs SLA breaches
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a contact is escalated right now?

talking_points: Live interaction events land in RAW.LIVE_INTERACTIONS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ESCALATED events with an SOP hint and the account's current risk band, then emails the on-call analyst.
tabs.call_out: From escalated contact to account case in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 14 synthetic escalation handling SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data for a fictional BPO provider, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
